source.manual_boundary: ChangesStockAllocation only changes ROSIZ on an existing stock row. The change itself never immediately orders; next demand or scheduled transfer reapplies the strategy. ROSIZ change can make the next order exceed its new value. Item transfers adjust nominal STSIZ and reorder point but do not themselves change configured ROSIZ; for a same-time ROSIZ change and transfer, the new ROSIZ is used to test whether a reorder is needed.
